title: What he would like to be doing now
summary: Disabled by his condition, he says he has done enough and would be happy resting.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: What do you feel that is?
Well, I have to wait until it gets here. Can get here now because I'm in this condition, can't do nothin'.
Ideally though, what would you like to be doing and performing?
What I'd like to do now? Nothing. It's all right. Nothin' is good, too, as long as you've done enough. I

think I've done enough, you know. I would lay down now and be peaceful. Then I could do a little of this and a little of that and it would be all right. But a whole lot of this and that, no good. I'm not able.
